title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 41
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 41: Gedaliah killed at Mizpah, the eighty men from the north, and Johanan's pursuit of Ishmael to Gibeon.

questions.text: How many men came with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to Gedaliah at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: In the seventh month Ishmael the son of Nethaniah came to Gedaliah at Mizpah with ten men, and there they ate bread together.

answers.text: Eight men
Eighty men
Ten men
Thirty men

questions.text: What did Ishmael and the men with him do to Gedaliah at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him arose and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam with the sword and killed him.

answers.text: They struck him with the sword and killed him
They carried him away captive to Ammon
They shut him up in the pit at Mizpah
They took his wine and summer fruits

questions.text: What position had the king of Babylon given Gedaliah, whom Ishmael killed?
questions.explanation: The text says the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor over the land.

answers.text: Captain of the guard
Keeper of the threshold
Chief of the scribes
Governor over the land

questions.text: Where did the eighty men come from who carried meal offerings and frankincense?
questions.explanation: Eighty men came from Shechem, from Shiloh and from Samaria, with their beards shaved and their clothes torn, bringing meal offerings and frankincense to Yahweh's house.

answers.text: From Moab, Ammon and Edom
From Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria
From Lachish, Azekah and Bethlehem
From Gibeon, Ramah and Anathoth

questions.text: What did Ishmael do as he went out from Mizpah to meet those men?
questions.explanation: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and said to them, "Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam."

answers.text: He hid himself until they had passed by
He sent ten men out ahead of him
He wept as he went, and invited them to Gedaliah
He set a watch at the gate of the city

questions.text: Why did Ishmael stop and not kill ten of the men?
questions.explanation: Ten men said to Ishmael not to kill them, because they had stores hidden in the field of wheat, barley, oil and honey; so he stopped and didn't kill them among their brothers.

answers.text: They had stores of wheat, barley, oil and honey
They promised to serve him in Ammon
They were his own brothers from Mizpah
They had come from Yahweh's house with offerings

questions.text: Who had made the pit which Ishmael filled with the dead bodies?
questions.explanation: The pit in which Ishmael cast the dead bodies was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel.

answers.text: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard
Baasha the king of Israel
Asa the king, for fear of Baasha

questions.text: Where was Ishmael going when he carried away captive the people who were left in Mizpah?
questions.explanation: Ishmael carried away captive all the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

answers.text: To the land of Egypt
Over to the children of Ammon
To Babylon with the captives
To Samaria in the north

questions.text: Where did Johanan and the captains find Ishmael?
questions.explanation: They took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

answers.text: By the great waters that are in Gibeon
In the plains of Jericho
At the entry of Pharaoh's house
In the middle gate of Jerusalem

questions.text: Where did Johanan and the people go to live, intending to enter Egypt?
questions.explanation: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt, because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

answers.text: At Mizpah, with the remnant of Judah
In Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin
In Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem
At Tahpanhes, in the land of Egypt
